title: Workspace baseline: one file, entries per package
description: The workspace Scan.toml sets one baseline for both packages. pkg_a and pkg_b have the same main.bal, so the same path and line in two packages: the package is hashed, so the 4 fingerprints differ. Paths are relative to the package root, so a package gets the same fingerprints alone and in the workspace. From the CLI a workspace member is always scanned with the whole workspace, so the scope of a package scanned alone is left to the unit tests. Each package is gated on its own new findings. Needs scan 0.15.0+.
upstream: BEP 1498: Finding fingerprints and baseline adoption (ballerina-spec/beps/tool-scan/1498_scan_baseline.md)

steps.note: Saved 4 entries; 2 for playground/ws_baseline_a and 2 for playground/ws_baseline_b, each with filePath main.bal.
